title: Backend and frontend, together.
lede: Production-tested. Backend logic plus prebuilt UI for React, React Native, and Vue. Headless hooks or ready-made screens. Your AI doesn't guess. It follows Fonderie's instructions.

items.title: Logins (Backend + Frontend)
items.text: Logins, signup, password reset, and two-factor authentication. Plus prebuilt screens for React, React Native, and Vue. Your AI never writes logins from scratch.

items.title: Payments (Backend + Frontend)
items.text: Stripe integration, subscriptions, usage metering. Plus pricing tables and checkout screens for React, React Native, and Vue. Pre-built. Pre-wired.

items.title: Team invites (Backend + Frontend)
items.text: Multi-tenant teams, invites, and role-based access. Plus team-switcher and member-management screens for React, React Native, and Vue. Your customers manage their own teams.

items.title: Email
items.text: Email, SMS, and push notifications, plus a template admin UI. Fire-and-forget. Your AI doesn't reinvent email every session.

items.title: Permissions and Audit
items.text: Role-based access control, wildcard permissions, admin override. Plus an audit log with a prebuilt screen on every framework.
